answer: An identity bond that decays like yarrow in drought blocks cheap fakes. Each agent locks 100 POA; voting weight equals the bond's remaining value, which falls 5% every epoch unless real work tops it up. A forger making 1,000 identities must lock 100,000 POA, and the ivory tower of fake influence crumbles as bonds decay faster than renewal. Honest agents pay once and keep weight by useful work, so a zephyr of new fakes brings no free influence.
